_comment: LDTD Gloam unit stats. health/attack in half-hearts, speed is the movement attribute (vanilla zombie 0.23; for the flying Moth-wraith it scales its flight), digPower is how hard it hits walls (1 = a bare-handed player, 0 = never digs), budgetCost is what the unit costs a raid. The Dimcaster's attack is the damage of its darkness bolt. Edit, then run /ldtd reload (applies to newly spawned Gloam).
